latest_release.name: v1.0.9
latest_release.body:
## What's new

This release brings together the major changes since **v1.0.3**, with a focus on building and working with your own team of AI coworkers.

**🤖 Bring your AI teammates into Spaces.** Create hosted **Hermes, Claude Code, and Codex** agents, or connect agents you already run—including Claude Code and Codex on your own computer. Give them roles and personalities, add them to a shared space, and let them work alongside you and each other. Choose who can ask each agent for help, follow its progress, and handle approvals in the conversation. Managed agents gain **Composio integrations** for connected services, and **super agents** can create other agents to delegate work to, with permission prompts on by default.

**🌐 Spaces on the web and on your phone.** Use [Spaces in your browser](https://spaces.rowboatlabs.com/) for conversations, agents, shared files, and notifications. The [iOS app](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/rowboat-spaces/id6818016444) gains richer messaging, editable notes and files, inline video, and invitations with QR codes. Links and notifications open the right conversation, even when the phone app is closed.

**💬 A simpler home for people, agents, and spaces.** The desktop now opens in **Spaces**, with **Spaces | Local** tabs to move between collaboration and your personal assistant. One sidebar brings together agents, spaces, and people. Invite someone directly to a space or through your personal link. Local coding now lives in **Projects** under Assistant, alongside regular chats and in-app file previews.

**🧵 Keep track of work across conversations.** A unified **Threads** page gathers your threads across spaces and shows which are working or need your attention. Use `/session` to start or return to a named work session. Follow up with the agent already working in a thread without mentioning it again, and choose to show replies inline.

**✅ Plan together with shared to-do boards.** Create a to-do list as a plain Markdown file, then switch between **Document** and **Board** views. Assign items to people or agents, drag them between sections, and keep supporting details with each task.

**🔎 Find things faster and control when you're available.** Search across your spaces with suggested filters for people, threads, and attachments. Set an active or away status, add a custom status, pause notifications, or schedule notification hours.

### Also improved

- More reliable Outlook and Granola sync when services ask Rowboat to slow down.
- A smoother Brain graph, clearer message formatting, and fixes for file previews and downloads.
- An **Anonymous usage analytics** toggle in Settings.
- A **Flatpak** download for Linux, plus fixes for tray behavior, window focus, and stale app locks.

**Upgrading from v1.0.3:** Spaces now uses one identity across spaces, with permissions managed per space. Create fresh invite links when sharing; older organization invites have been retired.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rowboatlabs/rowboat/compare/v1.0.3...v1.0.9
